d: For over six decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. The Group, in its endeavour to excel as a hybrid retailer, has reinforced its distribution and marketing services with a portfolio of eight owned brands and over 300 international brands in the luxury, beauty, fashion, and art de vivre categories. More recently, the Group expanded its expertise into new categories of luxury watches, jewellery, and eyewear.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken with the customer at heart. Be it constantly reinventing itself or focusing on innovation to provide luxury experiences at over 750+ experiential retail stores, online and through mobile apps, each touch point leads to delighting the customer.

Today, Chalhoub Group stands for 14,000 skilled and talented professionals across seven countries, whose cohesive efforts have resulted in the Group being ranked third in the Middle East and first in Saudi Arabia as a Great Place to Work®.

To keep the innovation journey going, the Group has set up “The Greenhouse”, which is not just an innovation hub, but also an incubator space and accelerator for start-ups and small businesses in the region and internationally. This is just one of the several initiatives taken by the Group to reinvent itself, catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. The Group has also been embedding sustainability at the core of its business strategy with a clear commitment towards people, partners and the planet, and by being a member of the United Nations Global Compact Community and signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles.

r: At Chalhoub we express the exceptional! As a Fashion Consultant you will be responsible for achieving individual and collective sales targets while delivering exceptional Guest Experience; and ensuring support in the implementation of CRM, CX and other key customer and people initiatives in-store.
You will collect data on customer behaviour, top sellers, slow movers which will be key input for business reviews
Drive client relationships within an omni-channel approach
Drive eNPS through people experience initiatives and culture
Ensure adherence to VM guidelines and Standard operating procedures (SOPs)
Ensure click and collect are conducted within SLAs (Service-level agreement)
Ensure customer data is properly captured in adherence to marketing team requirements
Promote loyalty program (MUSE) and stay up-to-date with app offerings etc..
Support with in-store marketing events and activations
Keep abreast of all brand social media activities and campaigns
Provide input to what’s working well/what’s not working well within the store

d: At ZAJEL, we pride ourselves on delivering tomorrow’s innovation today. Our mission is to redefine logistics through cutting-edge technology, reliable global solutions, and a customer-first approach. Since our journey began in 2008, we have grown to become one of the UAE’s fastest-growing logistics companies, trusted by enterprises, SMEs, and individuals alike.

We specialize in express courier, freight, special projects, and government services, delivering tailored, cost-effective solutions—from domestic and international logistics to sector-specific expertise—empowering businesses to thrive efficiently at every step.
As a proud member of the International Chamber of Digital Economy (ICDE), we stay ahead of industry trends, driving forward-thinking solutions that go beyond boundaries.
By combining trust, innovation, and advanced systems, we are committed to creating a smarter, more connected logistics future for our customers—delivering excellence, everywhere.

The Manager, Operation – Express is responsible for ensuring efficient functioning of the ZAJEL’s operations by planning, managing couriers as well as resolving customers’ issues, complaints, and escalations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering or a related field.
7-10 years of experience in an Operations Manager role.
Proven experience within the logistics and supply chain industry.
Strong knowledge of operational planning, process improvement, warehouse management, transportation, and supply chain optimization.
Experience managing teams, KPIs, budgets, and operational performance.
Proficient in data analysis, reporting, and continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
r: Establishes internal guidelines and procedures for the operations department to ensure high performance from the department
Implements adequate workflow systems, monitoring mechanisms, and control mechanisms to ensure the expected service levels are delivered
Plans and assigns route for the couriers as per the load and deliveries value
Handles customers’ incidents and complaints related to his/her team and handles escalations if any
Monitors the daily operational transactions, checks pending deliveries and pickups and takes corrective action accordingly
Monitors transit time performance against actual performance targets
Modifies department work plans according to changes in operations such as leave, holiday, or a heavy workload
Interacts with various business units (Call Center, Customer Service, Operations, Fleet and Logistics & Cargo) to plan and execute client requirements

Oversees all aspects of recruiting, training and continually developing a highly competent and motivated team of operations team members, including strategic plans to ensure staffing is appropriate at all times

Leads these processes effectively – sets individual objectives, recruits qualified staff, manages performance, develops and motivates staff, providing formal and informal feedback / appraisal in order to maximize subordinate and functional performance
Coordinates operational activities related to the team such as monitoring and submitting timesheets, leave regulation etc.
Mentors operations team and provides 'hands-on' technical leadership as required

d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

r: Support the day-to-day management of Binance’s social media accounts, with a key focus on X, including content planning, creation, scheduling, publishing, and community engagement in line with the established content strategy.
Strong knowledge of X and its content formats, audience behaviors, community dynamics, and platform best practices, with experience creating engaging, timely, and culturally relevant content.
Use AI tools as a core part of your content workflow to create platform-ready visuals, GIFs, memes and short-form videos that meet brand standards and drive engagement.
Research, develop, and execute engaging social content, adapting ideas and formats to platform-specific audiences and brand priorities.
Monitor emerging social media trends, relevant conversations, industry developments, and cultural moments, identifying opportunities to create timely, engaging, and brand-relevant content.

Support weekly and monthly social media performance reporting using existing analytics and reporting tools, tracking key metrics and identifying opportunities to improve engagement and channel performance.
Analyze published content performance and contribute recommendations on formats, messaging, timing, and creative approaches.
Monitor social conversations, audience engagement, and community sentiment, flagging emerging issues and potential reputational risks to senior team members.
Assist in coordinating content assets, approvals, publishing timelines, and deliverables with external agencies and partners.
Follow established social media processes, playbooks, and reporting frameworks, while identifying opportunities to improve workflows and content performance.
Stay up to date on emerging AI tools and content creation techniques, experimenting with new workflows to improve creative quality, production efficiency, and social media engagement.
